'''Magna''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], known as the "[[The Force/Legends|Force]] giving star." It had a surface on which [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] could land.<ref name="EBC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SW_Electronic_Battle_Command_Game.jpg|250px|thumb|''Star Wars: Electronic Battle Game'', Magna's only appearance]]
Magna was an element in the ''[[Star Wars: Electronic Battle Command]]'' game released by [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] in [[1979]]. Players win the game by being the only one with any remaining "Force units," which can be drained by combat and [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]], and can be replenished by reaching Magna. The star was seen only as a red LED light on the game's screen.<ref name="Manual">{{WebCite|url=https://www.manualslib.com/manual/1428928/Kenner-Electronic-Battle-Command-Star-Wars.html|text=''Star Wars: Electronic Battle Command'' Game - Game Play manual|work=[http://gomi321.com Gomi's Nostalgia Site]|format=PDF|archivedate=20210923151947}}</ref>
